tier_should.rationale: Clear, timely thesis on citation incentives and stagnation; integrates literature and proposes measurement. Limited novel theory/causal evidence; largely conceptual. Suitable for solid field outlets (e.g., science policy/econ of science), not top general.

tier_will.rationale: Authors’ reputations and NBER visibility increase chances at higher-tier field journal. If empirical measures of novelty are credible, fit is strong for Research Policy or JEP-style venues; still unlikely for top-five general.
